Subject: Your Gold Member Perks Are Waiting – Free Shipping on Your Next Order
Body: We've noticed it's been a while since your last visit, and we'd love to welcome you back. As a Gold member, you enjoy free standard shipping on every order—no minimum spend required—plus free return shipping on eligible items, making it easy to shop outdoor gear and footwear risk-free. Come back to NorthStar and rediscover what you love.
contexts:
[POL-LOY-011:010:cdbdbe1ea2 | POL-LOY-011 | 4. Tier Benefits]
## 4. Tier Benefits

| Benefit | Bronze | Silver | Gold | Platinum |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Points earn rate | 1× | 1.25× | 1.5× | 2× |
| Birthday reward | $5 | $10 | $20 | $40 |
| Free standard shipping | $75+ | $50+ | Always | Always |
| Free return shipping | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Return window | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | **60 days** |
| Early access to sales | No | 12 hours | 24 hours | 48 hours |
| Free gear repair | No | No | 2 per year | Unlimited |
| Dedicated support line | No | No | No | Yes |
| Annual gear credit | No | No | No | $100 |

Benefits are tied to the member's tier at the time the benefit is used, except the return window, which is fixed at the tier held **at the time of purchase** (see POL-RET-004 §1.1).

[KB-FAQ-022:003:716beea738 | KB-FAQ-022 | Loyalty]
## Loyalty

**How do I move up a tier?**
Tier is based on trailing 12-month merchandise spend: Bronze under $500, Silver $500, Gold $2,000, Platinum $5,000. Upgrades happen immediately when you cross a threshold.

**Why did I get downgraded?**
Your trailing 12-month spend fell below your tier's threshold. Downgrades are evaluated monthly, move you down only one tier at a time, and we email you 30 days beforehand. If you have held Gold or Platinum for 24 months or more, you get one automatic downgrade protection per 24-month period.

**Do returns affect my tier?**
Yes. A refund reduces your trailing spend and can trigger a downgrade.

**When do my points expire?**
18 months after your most recent qualifying purchase — not 18 months after you earned them. Any purchase resets the clock on your whole balance. We warn you at 60 days and again at 14 days.

**What are my points worth?**
100 points equals $5. Redeem in increments of 100.

**Can I combine a promo code with points?**
Usually yes. You cannot combine two targeted offers with each other.

**My offer expired. Can you extend it?**
No. Expired offers cannot be reinstated by customer service or by any automated system.

**What happens to my points if I close my account?**
They are forfeited immediately and are not restored if you rejoin. Accounts with no purchase for 36 months close automatically.

---

[POL-RET-004:003:c35321e3fd | POL-RET-004 | 1. Standard Return Window / 1.1 Extended Window for Platinum Members]
### 1.1 Extended Window for Platinum Members

**Platinum loyalty members receive a 60-day return window** on all eligible merchandise. This is an automatic benefit; the member does not need to request it and no approval is required.

The extended window applies based on the member's tier **at the time of purchase**, not at the time of return. A customer who was Gold when they purchased and reached Platinum afterwards receives the standard 30-day window for that order.

[POL-LOY-011:003:8c4328c83f | POL-LOY-011 | 2. Tiers]
## 2. Tiers

Tier is determined by **trailing 12-month spend**, evaluated on the first day of each month.

| Tier | Trailing 12-month spend | Members (approx.) |
|---|---|---|
| **Bronze** | Under $500 | 61% |
| **Silver** | $500 – $1,999.99 | 26% |
| **Gold** | $2,000 – $4,999.99 | 10% |
| **Platinum** | $5,000 and above | 3% |

Spend counts merchandise only. Gift card purchases, taxes, shipping charges, and amounts refunded through returns do **not** count toward tier qualification. A return reduces trailing spend and can cause a tier downgrade.
